Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Vinod - 46 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Kunal stands on the road. Pallavi and Vinod stand near him.]

Pallavi: "What lovely weather!"

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Kunal sits in the back seat.]

Vinod: "Hmm, I see."

[Kunal sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Kunal: "Mom, are you okay?"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Kunal in the back.]

Pallavi: "What a day to remember!"
